name: join-preview
title: Join Preview
description: Join preview that predicts the row count for each join type, names repeated keys that fan rows out, counts rows dropped for no match or a blank key, and catches keys that never match (number vs text, spaces, case, leading zeros), with fixes that say how many rows they rescue.

meta.summary: Predicts a join's row count before it runs, so repeated keys that duplicate rows or keys that never match don't go unnoticed.
catches: Repeated keys that fan rows out (and break an expected m:1)
Rows dropped for having no match or a blank key
Keys that differ only by type: number vs text
Keys that differ by spaces, case or leading zeros
Row count for inner, left, right and outer joins side by side
limits: Runs on the sample rows you pass, in the browser; large tables need a server-side count
Normalisations are opt-in and may merge keys that really are different
Predicts counts; it doesn't run your SQL or know your database's collation and type coercion
a11y: Section is labelled with both table names
Join type is a radiogroup with roving tabindex, arrow keys, Home and End
Counts are in a polite live region; failures use role=alert
Run button shows aria-busy while pending
